note: The lift (F5, Matt, October 23, 2026): a thing the pointer rests on, or whose card is open, is lifted in its own shader instead of ringed on the ground (src/render/lift.js, src/shaders/lib-lift.wgsl). tint: a warm colour (linear, about 1 at its brightest) the thing's own light is multiplied toward, by tintStrength at full lift. rim: a thin rim of light at the thing's edge, rimStrength times rim (pre-exposed, so it reads the same by day and by night), narrower as rimPower grows. It eases in over fadeInS and out over fadeOutS seconds. What a card lifts: a ground spot the pickups within their spread plus spotPadM of its middle, a small heap within heapM, a pile within its own ring (at least pileMinM), a log or stone within pieceMatchM of its middle, anything else (a creature, a find, a net, a camp prop) within matchM.
